theorem axial_exact {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hleft : ∀ n x, x ∈ U → a ≤ r.length n x * r.inner)

      CorrectionState.rankDesiredAxial r c u n (p.1, p.2.1)
